title: DIWALI GET-TOGETHER
summary: A BIG thank you to everyone for making our Diwali Meet-and-Greet a grand success!! Your presence, warmth and infectious energy made the evening truly unforgettable.
description:
A BIG thank you to everyone for making our Diwali Meet-and-Greet a grand success!! Your presence, warmth and infectious energy made the evening truly unforgettable. The beautiful views added a magical touch and watching everyone dance their hearts out made the evening even more special.

A special thank you to JSJ Jewellers- 55 years legacy of trust, for sponsoring 2 bumper prizes worth ₹15,000 each.These vouchers can be redeemed at their Andheri West showroom to get jewellery of your choice crafted in real diamonds

We are equally grateful to Rajesh Choudhary for sponsoring 2 bumper prizes worth ₹3,000 each, redeemable at any of his three restaurants – Era, Osteria or Pouring Verandah.

And finally, a heartfelt thank you to each and every one of you. It's the people, the laughter, the love and all those little moments together that make celebrations truly special.

Total 113 guests have attended this event including 70 members.

We couldn't have asked for a more wonderful evening
